transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well, to be honest, what really scared me enough to make an appointment is that I've been hearing things. I keep hearing my name being called from the hallway at my house. And... it even happened once at work, at the warehouse, when I knew for a fact nobody else was around. It's not like a faint whisper or something in my head, it sounds just as clear and real as if my husband was standing right next to me talking to me.
Besides hearing your name called, have you noticed any other unusual sounds, sights, or sensations that others don't seem to notice?

No, I haven't. It's... it's really just hearing my name. I haven't seen anything that isn't there, or felt anything weird like that. Just that voice. That's honestly enough to rattle me, but yeah, nothing besides that.
Have you ever had any thoughts or beliefs that other people don't seem to understand, or that you know others might find strange or untrue?

No, I haven't had anything like that. I mean, I know hearing the voice is strange, but my actual thoughts? No. I don't have any weird beliefs or ideas that people don't understand. I just go to work, do my stocking, and come home. My thoughts are just normal, everyday stuff. It's really just hearing my name that's out of the ordinary.
Have you heard any other voices or sounds besides your name being called, like people talking to each other or commenting on what you're doing?
No, nothing like that. It's just my name. I haven't heard anyone having a conversation or... or talking about what I'm doing. Just the one voice calling for me, and that's it.
Have you ever had thoughts or ideas that you know are unusual or that others might not believe, even if they don’t involve hearing voices?

No, I really haven't. Like I said before, my thoughts are pretty normal. I don't have any strange ideas or beliefs that people would think are weird. I just focus on my work at the store and getting through the day. The only thing that's unusual is hearing my name, but my thoughts themselves are just... regular.
Have you ever had any beliefs or ideas that you know are not shared by others, or that you think others might consider untrue or strange, even if you haven’t talked about them?

I think you just asked me that, but... no. I really don't. I don't have any secret ideas I'm keeping to myself, or anything like that. I'm just a regular person trying to get through my day. Like I said, I just focus on my job and my normal life. There's really nothing else going on in my head besides hearing my name.
Have you ever had any thoughts or experiences that you’ve kept to yourself because you were worried others wouldn’t understand or might think they’re strange?

Honestly, doctor, I feel like we're going in circles here. I haven't kept anything hidden. I don't have any strange thoughts or experiences that I'm worried about sharing. Like I've been saying, the only thing that's bothering me is hearing my name when no one is there. Other than that, everything is just normal.
Have you ever had any beliefs or ideas that you think might not be true, but you still feel strongly about them even when others say they aren't real or reasonable?

Doctor, I... I really don't know how else to say it. No. I don't have any beliefs like that. I'm not holding onto anything that isn't real. I just go to work, stock the shelves, and come home. That's it. I'm not sure why you keep asking me this same kind of question, but the answer is still no.
Have you ever had any experiences where you strongly believed something was true, even though others told you it wasn’t, and later you realized they were right?

Look, doctor... no. I really haven't. I know you probably have a checklist of things you need to ask, but I've never had anything like that happen. I've never been convinced of something that turned out to be completely wrong or made up. Like I said, it's just hearing my name when nobody is there. That's the only unusual thing going on with me.
Have you ever had any strong beliefs or ideas that you held onto even when others gave you clear reasons to doubt them, even if you didn’t talk about them or act on them?

I... I mean, I feel like you're just asking me the exact same thing again. No. I haven't. I don't have any secret ideas or strong beliefs that people have to talk me out of. I don't hold onto things like that. I'm just a regular person going about my day. I really don't have anything else to tell you on this.
Have you ever had any beliefs or suspicions that you kept to yourself because you thought they were too strange to share, even if you weren't sure if they were completely true?

Doctor, I'm trying to be as clear as I can. No, I haven't kept any strange suspicions or beliefs to myself. I don't have anything like that going on in my head. I go to work, do my job, and come home. There's nothing I'm hiding or keeping secret because it's too weird. I just don't have those kinds of thoughts.
Have you ever had any thoughts or beliefs that you knew were unusual, even if you didn’t share them with others or they didn’t last very long?

I really don't know how else to say it. No. I haven't had any unusual thoughts or beliefs, even short ones. I'm just stocking shelves and trying to get by. I don't have anything like what you're looking for.
Have you ever had any experiences where you believed something strongly, even if it turned out not to be true, even for a short time?

Doctor, we're just going in circles here. No, I haven't. I haven't believed anything strongly that turned out to be false, not even for a minute. I really don't know what you want me to say. I'm just telling you the truth—I don't have these kinds of thoughts or beliefs you keep asking about.
Have you ever had any thoughts or beliefs that you felt were absolutely true at the time, even if they didn’t turn out to be correct, even for a short while?

Look, I... I really don't have a different answer for you. It's still no. I haven't had any thoughts like that, not even for a little bit. I feel like you're asking the exact same thing again, and my answer is just... no. I don't have anything else to tell you about this.

Have you ever had any experiences where you believed something strongly that others told you wasn't true, even if only for a short time, like someone being after you, a special connection with someone you don't actually know, or something like that?

Doctor, I... I don't know how many different ways I can say this. No. Nobody was after me, I don't think I have a special connection to anybody... I just haven't had anything like that happen. I'm just a normal person going to work. I really don't have any of these experiences you keep asking about.

Have you ever had any experiences where you believed something strongly that wasn’t true, even if only for a short time, like thinking someone was watching you, sending you messages, or that you had a special role or identity that others didn’t recognize?

I... I really don't know what else to say. It's still no. I've never thought anyone was watching me or sending me messages, and I definitely don't think I have some kind of special identity. I just stock shelves for a living. I'm sorry, but my answer is still the same. I haven't experienced any of those things.

Have you ever had any thoughts or beliefs that you knew were not based in reality, even if only for a short time, such as thinking you had special powers, were being followed, or that something was happening that wasn't actually real?

Doc, I... I feel like we're just going in circles now. It's still no. I don't have any special powers, and nobody is following me. I know what's real and what isn't. Like I said, I just go to my job at the store and come home. I really don't have any of these beliefs you keep asking me about.

Have you ever had any experiences where you believed something very strongly, even if it turned out not to be true at all, like someone was trying to communicate with you in a hidden way or that something had a special meaning just for you?

Look, doctor, I... I feel like you're just asking me the exact same thing but using different words. No, I don't get hidden messages from anywhere, and things don't have secret meanings for me. A box of cereal on the shelf is just a box of cereal. I really don't have anything like that to tell you, no matter how many times you ask it.

Have you ever had any beliefs that you knew were not true but you still couldn’t shake the feeling that they were real, even for a short time, such as thinking something was meant for you specifically or that you were receiving special messages?

Honestly, doctor, I don't know how many different ways I can say no to this. I really don't have feelings like that. Nobody is sending me messages, and nothing is meant just for me. I just... I don't have those kinds of thoughts, and I don't know why we keep coming back to it.

Have you ever had any beliefs that you knew were not based on reality, even if only for a little while, such as thinking that you were someone else, that someone was trying to harm you, or that ordinary things had a special meaning just for you?

Doc, we're doing it again... I really don't know what else to tell you. No. I don't think I'm somebody else, and nobody is out to get me or harm me. I'm just me. Like I've been saying, I go to work, I stock the shelves, and I go home. I haven't had any of these thoughts you keep asking about, and I just don't have a different answer to give you.
